Container.Name: Fantasy-WarRoom
Container.Overview: Fantasy football draft companion. Set your league's scoring and roster format (or import it live from Sleeper), import rankings, and run a live draft board with pick-by-pick recommendations weighted by real roster needs. Can live-sync picks from an in-progress Sleeper draft. Saved rankings sets are stored server-side under the Data path below, so they persist across restarts/updates and are shared across every device that hits this container. Live draft state itself stays in the browser.
